title: Protein quant record
description: One record per (protein, sample) in proteins.jsonl. Top3avg exactly as the method note defines it: per-peptide MAX matched_intensity, sorted descending, mean of the top 3 or fewer. Never padded.

top3avg.description: Mean of the top n_peptides_used per-peptide maxima.

n_peptides_used.description: 1, 2 or 3. CRITICAL to carry: a 1-peptide Top3avg is not comparable to a 3-peptide one, and padding to 3 is forbidden.

n_peptides_matched.description: All peptides matched, including those not used.

rank.description: Position within this sample, 1 = highest Top3avg.

percentile.description: Preferred over rank for cross-sample comparison, because protein counts differ per sample.

normalized.description: Whichever normalizations the method asked for. Each is a deliberate choice with a cost, so each is named rather than implied.

within_protein_max.description: Protein's own max across samples = 1.0. Keeps samples comparable; ERASES cross-sample scale anomalies.

absolute_log10.description: log10 of raw Top3avg. Preserves anomalies (e.g. a 300-1000x sample) at the cost of legibility on a linear axis.

median_scaled.description: Divided by the sample's median Top3avg. A loading correction.

reference_ratio.description: Ratio to the method's reference protein in the SAME run.
